items.prompt: The first diagonal entry is 0 but another row has a nonzero entry in that column. What may help?

options.text: Declare the matrix singular without examining other rows
options.why: A zero unpivoted entry alone is insufficient.

options.text: Swap the corresponding equations, including RHS entries
options.why: A valid row operation can supply a nonzero pivot without changing solutions.

options.text: Swap only RHS entries and leave A fixed
Set every unknown to 0 without checking
options.why: A fabricated vector need not satisfy any equation.

items.explanation: A row swap acts on the entire augmented equation. Pivoting precedes a singularity conclusion based on an exhausted pivot column.
